description: PcapPlusPlus is a multiplatform C++ library for capturing, parsing and crafting of network packets. It is designed to be efficient, powerful and easy to use. It provides C++ wrappers for the most popular packet processing engines such as libpcap, Npcap, WinPcap, DPDK, AF_XDP, WinDivert and PF_RING.

summary.one_liner: PcapPlusPlus is a multiplatform C++ library for capturing, parsing, editing and crafting network packets, with wrappers over libpcap, Npcap, WinPcap, DPDK, AF_XDP, WinDivert and PF_RING.
summary.what_it_does: It provides a C++ wrapper for packet capture engines such as libpcap, Npcap, WinPcap, Intel DPDK, eBPF AF_XDP, WinDivert, ntop's PF_RING and raw sockets. It parses, edits and generates packets across a large list of protocols, from Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4/IPv6 and TCP/UDP up to application protocols such as DNS, DHCP, HTTP headers, LDAP, Modbus, BGP, SIP and SOME/IP. It reads and writes PCAP and PCAPNG files. It includes TCP reassembly, IPv4/IPv6 fragmentation and defragmentation, a user-friendly packet filter layer over BPF filters, and JA3/JA3S TLS fingerprinting. The README says it runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, Android and FreeBSD.
use_cases: capture network traffic from C++ applications
parse packets from pcap or pcapng files
craft or modify custom network packets
high-speed packet processing with DPDK or PF_RING
how_to_run: git clone the repository and follow the Build From Source instructions on the project website
notable: Parses and crafts a large set of protocols across L2 to L7, including editing support for many of them
Wraps DPDK, eBPF AF_XDP and PF_RING behind a simpler C++ interface
Includes a TCP reassembly implementation handling retransmission and out-of-order segments
Release packages from v23.09 onward are signed with GitHub attestation and can be verified with gh CLI
Benchmarked against other C++ packet libraries such as libtins and libcrafter
caveats: Several protocols (IPSec, QUIC, SSL/TLS, MySQL, SSH, X509, and others) are parsing only with no editing support
High-speed DPDK and PF_RING support requires those frameworks to be set up separately
Building from source requires following platform-specific instructions on the project website
